name: md-root-module-repo-relative
body: `requirements.constraint.md-fqn-stability` governs the non-root `md.*` identities. `requirements.requirement.md-lang-id-preserved` asserts the heading and directory FQNs keep their `md.<repo-relative-dir>` form, while the repo-root module renders repo-relative to the git toplevel / scan root (`md.`, per SPEC.md §4.3's `<repo-relative-dir>` rule), matching `requirements.requirement.portable-graph-identity`, `requirements.requirement.frontend-rooting-from-repo-base`, the law barring a checkout-named module, and `domain.value.module-identity`. Heading Structs are file-rooted (`md.<repo-relative-file>.md.<heading>`, e.g. `md.AGENTS.md.apg-agent-guide`), so they embed zero module identity and stay unchanged. The bundled structural scanner carries the Markdown stream: the Markdown directory walk is `rust.structfrontend.discovery.walk`, the doc/heading build is `rust.structfrontend.md.build_doc`, and the repo-relative identity rendering is `rust.apg.ingest.identity.repo_relative_identity`.
